note: pwa_extras injects Apple/iOS PWA tags from the config object pwa_extras.settings.apple (touch_icons, mask_color default #0678be, meta_tags, color_select in {default,black,black_translucent}, home_screen_icons). Form at /admin/config/pwa/pwa_extras (route pwa_extras.settings, permission administer pwa). Depends on pwa. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real pwa_extras.settings.apple config keys read/written via drush.

evals.prompt: What does the pwa_extras module add to a Drupal PWA, and in which config object are its settings stored?
evals.expected_output: It adds Apple/iOS-specific PWA metadata (apple-touch-icons, status-bar style, pinned-tab mask color, home-screen splash icons). Settings are stored in the pwa_extras.settings.apple config object.

evals.prompt: At what admin path is the PWA Extras settings form, and which permission controls it?
evals.expected_output: The form is at /admin/config/pwa/pwa_extras (route pwa_extras.settings); it uses the base module's 'administer pwa' permission (pwa_extras defines no permissions of its own).

evals.prompt: Which pwa_extras setting controls the color of the Safari pinned-tab (mask) icon, and what is its default value?
evals.expected_output: The 'mask_color' setting in pwa_extras.settings.apple; its default is #0678be.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the PWA Extras pinned-tab mask icon color has been customized. Inspect the live configuration and state the current mask_color value.
evals.expected_output: pwa_extras.settings.apple mask_color is '#abcdef' (default #0678be); read with `drush cget pwa_extras.settings.apple mask_color`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the PWA Extras iOS status-bar style has been changed from its default. Inspect the live configuration and state the current color_select value.
evals.expected_output: pwa_extras.settings.apple color_select is 'black' (default 'default'); read with `drush cget pwa_extras.settings.apple color_select`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure PWA Extras so the Safari pinned-tab mask icon color is '#ff0000'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set pwa_extras.settings.apple mask_color to '#ff0000' (e.g. drush cset pwa_extras.settings.apple mask_color '#ff0000' -y).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure PWA Extras so the iOS status-bar style is set to black-translucent (the color_select value 'black_translucent'). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set pwa_extras.settings.apple color_select to 'black_translucent' (e.g. drush cset pwa_extras.settings.apple color_select black_translucent -y).
